'''Maul's Lightsaber''' is a [[persona]]: every card that represents this character counts as the same character, whatever its title, and each player may have only one card of a persona on the table at a time.<ref name="ar2023">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Players Committee Advanced Rulebook] (2023), Chapter 5, Personas, and Appendix D, Persona Lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192915/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The 5 card pages of the Maul's Lightsaber persona fall under 4 card titles, listed below in release order (Decipher cards first, then the Players Committee's Virtual cards).

== Cards ==
=== Maul's Lightsaber ===

| [[File:Tat-D-maulslightsaber.gif|200px|link=Maul's Lightsaber]] || [[Maul's Lightsaber|Maul's Lightsaber]] || [[Tatooine]] || Weapon || destiny 1 || First card of this persona || Deploy on Maul. While on Maul, may not be stolen. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny &gt; defense value.
|}
